entries.description: Read spec, planning docs, and Orders-related code; identified that jdoe signs into the internal org as BackofficeUser and ApplyRowFilter returns Where(_=>false) when ActiveOrganizationId.HasValue and CustomerId is null.

Traced row-filter pipeline: IRowFilterService is registered but unused; OrderService.ApplyRowFilter hardcodes logic that filters by CustomerId when any ActiveOrganizationId is set, regardless of role. CurrentUserService.Role returns highest role from claims.
Confirmed rule from config and role description: Customer -> own orders only; BackofficeUser and above -> all orders. Matches security-config.json RowFilters which only scopes the Customer role.

Rewrote OrderService.ApplyRowFilter to key off role only: Role >= BackofficeUser -> pass-through; Customer with CustomerId -> filter; Customer with no CustomerId -> deny-all. Removes the ActiveOrganizationId.HasValue branch that caused the bug.
Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests/OrderVisibilityTests.cs with three real-DB cases: BackofficeUser jdoe sees total order count; Customer sees only own orders; SystemAdmin sees all.
Added OrdersList_AsBackofficeUser_ShowsSeededOrdersAsync to OrdersWorkflowTests.cs exercising the drawer-driven nav as jdoe.

dotnet build: success (0 warnings, 0 errors). dotnet test: 561 passed; one pre-existing failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates references docs/workflow-auth-observability.md which was removed in commit 8730107 and is unrelated to this session). All 3 new OrderVisibilityTests pass.
Cross-provider verification via router (model: opus); raw review saved.
Kickoff clarification: user confirmed expected scope is 'full detail-page editing (status + line items + customer)' like the products detail page.

Reproduced by reading OrderDetailPage.razor, OrderDetail.razor, ProductDetailPage.razor. Root cause identified: OrderDetailPage hardcodes IsReadOnly=true, so status buttons, Add Product, Remove items, Add/Edit/Delete notes are never rendered for any role. Also, no UpdateOrder endpoint or API client method exists for editing an existing order's header (Notes, ShipDate) — OrderDetailState.SaveAsync returns false whenever !isNew.

Traced OrderDetail -> OrderDetailState -> OrderApiClient -> OrdersController -> OrderService. Confirmed: endpoint-level authorization is the actual gate (Products follows 'show edit UI to everyone; API enforces auth' pattern). Row filter in OrderService.ApplyRowFilter correctly scopes existing-order mutations to the caller's CustomerId for Customer role.

Implemented across server and client: added IOrderService.UpdateAsync + OrderService.UpdateAsync (updates Notes, ShipDate, ModifiedDate, ModifiedBy; row-filtered); added OrdersController UpdateAsync at PUT /api/orders/{id} with [DabblerEndpointAuthorize('UpdateOrder')]; added UpdateOrder endpoint permission to security-config.json (SystemAdmin, BackofficeUserAdmin, BackofficeUser); added OrderApiClient.UpdateAsync; updated OrderDetailState.SaveAsync to route to create-on-new and update-on-existing; flipped OrderDetailPage IsReadOnly to false; added Save/Undo toolbar for existing orders to OrderDetail with dirty-state tracking over Notes and ShipDate; rewired Notes TextField and ShipDate DatePicker to change-callbacks that drive dirty state; updated OrderDetailState.UpdateStatusAsync to re-fetch the order after a status change so server-side side effects (ShipDate on Shipped) show in the UI.

Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests/OrderUpdateTests.cs with two real-DB cases: SystemAdmin updates Notes and ShipDate and the change persists (then restores); a different Customer cannot update another customer's order (row filter returns null, DB unchanged).

Added OrderDetail_SystemAdmin_CanEditNotesAndPersistAsync to tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/OrdersWorkflowTests.cs. Drives drawer -> /orders, clicks the first row, asserts Save/Undo/Add Product controls are visible and Save/Undo start disabled, edits Notes, asserts Save enables, clicks Save, re-fetches the order via API and asserts Notes persisted, then restores the original Notes so later tests aren't affected. Updated the file's header doc-comment which previously stated IsReadOnly=true was the current state.

Updated tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests/Services/OrderDetailStateTests.cs: replaced the outdated SaveAsync_RequiresNewRecordAndSuccessfulCreate test with SaveAsync_CreatesNewOrderThroughClient (create path) and SaveAsync_UpdatesExistingOrderThroughClient (update path).

dotnet build: success (0 errors, 1 pre-existing warning in WebGuardrailTests). dotnet test (non-Playwright): 547 passed, 1 pre-existing failure in WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates (missing docs/workflow-auth-observability.md from commit 8730107 — same unrelated failure noted in Session 1). New tests: 2/2 OrderUpdateTests pass, 2/2 OrderDetailStateTests create/update cases pass.
Cross-provider verification via router (model: opus); raw review saved.
Round-2 verification after fixes applied to round-1 issues (model: opus).
